title: Tall and short
summary: Describe people with pairs of opposites and say what someone is not with لَيْسَ.
intro: لَيْسَ means 'is not'. It changes with the person, like a verb: لَسْتُ (I am not), لَسْتَ (you are not, to a man), لَيْسَ (he is not), لَيْسَتْ (she is not). The adjective after it takes the ending ـًا: عُمَر لَيْسَ طَوِيلًا (Omar is not tall), and نُور لَيْسَتْ طَوِيلَةً (Nour is not tall).
objectives: Describe people with six adjectives: tall, short, thin, strong, calm and young
Say 'is not' with لَيْسَ, لَيْسَتْ and لَسْتُ
Add ـًا to the adjective after لَيْسَ

realLife.title: Back to back
realLife.story: After lunch, Sami's little brother Omar tells Daniel that he is tall and strong and wants to play basketball. Their little sister Nour laughs at him, and she makes Omar and Daniel stand back to back to see who is taller.

sentences.en: Omar is not tall; he is short.
sentences.literal: Omar is not tall, he (is) short

mistakes.why: After لَيْسَ the adjective takes the ending ـًا in correct MSA.
For a woman or a girl, لَيْسَ becomes لَيْسَتْ.

sentences.en: I am not as strong as you.
sentences.literal: I am not strong like you

sentences.en: Sami is a tall, thin young man.
sentences.literal: Sami (is) a young man tall and thin

sentences.ar: أُخْتِي هَادِئَة، لٰكِنَّ أَخِي لَيْسَ هَادِئًا أَبَدًا!
sentences.en: My sister is calm, but my brother is not calm at all!
sentences.literal: my sister (is) calm, but my brother is not calm ever

sentences.en: Are you tall like your mother?

dialogue.title: Who is taller?
dialogue.culture: Praise for a child, such as 'he is tall' or 'she is clever', is often followed by مَا شَاءَ اللّٰه, to show the praise is sincere and to wish the child well. Direct remarks about an adult's weight or height are best avoided.

lines.ar: يَا دَانْيَال، أَنَا قَوِيّ جِدًّا وَطَوِيل! هَلْ تُحِبُّ كُرَةَ السَّلَّة؟ تَعَالَ نَلْعَبْ!
lines.en: Daniel, I'm very strong and tall! Do you like basketball? Come on, let's play!
segs: you like, you love (to a man)

lines.ar: يَا عُمَر، أَنْتَ لَسْتَ طَوِيلًا! أَنْتَ قَصِير مِثْلِي، وَدَانْيَال طَوِيل جِدًّا.
lines.en: Omar, you are not tall! You're short like me, and Daniel is very tall.

lines.ar: أَنَا لَسْتُ قَصِيرًا يَا نُور! أَنَا طِفْل، وَالْأَطْفَال يَكْبَرُونَ بِسُرْعَة.
lines.en: I am not short, Nour! I'm a child, and children grow up fast.

lines.ar: عُمَر عَلَى حَقّ، هُوَ لَيْسَ قَصِيرًا، وَهُوَ قَوِيّ جِدًّا لِوَلَد صَغِير!
lines.en: Omar is right: he isn't short, and he is very strong for a little boy!

lines.ar: حَسَنًا، نَقِيسُ الْآن! يَا دَانْيَال، قِفْ هُنَا مَعَ عُمَر، ظَهْرًا لِظَهْر.
lines.en: All right, let's measure now! Daniel, stand here with Omar, back to back.

lines.ar: أَنَا جَاهِز! أَنَا طَوِيل مِثْلَ دَانْيَال، صَحِيح؟ قُولِي الْحَقِيقَة يَا نُور!
lines.en: I'm ready! I'm as tall as Daniel, right? Tell the truth, Nour!

lines.ar: لَا! رَأْسُكَ هُنَا، عِنْدَ كَتِفِ دَانْيَال. أَنْتَ لَسْتَ طَوِيلًا مِثْلَهُ أَبَدًا!
lines.en: No! Your head is here, at Daniel's shoulder. You are not nearly as tall as him!

lines.ar: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُونَ؟ آهْ، أَعْرِفُ: مَنِ الطَّوِيل وَمَنِ الْقَصِير؟ هٰذِهِ لُعْبَتُنَا الْقَدِيمَة!
lines.en: What are you all doing? Ah, I know: who is tall and who is short? That's our old game!

lines.ar: يَا سَامِي، أَنْتَ طَوِيل أَيْضًا، لٰكِنَّكَ نَحِيف جِدًّا. هَلْ تَأْكُلُ؟
lines.en: Sami, you're tall too, but you're very thin. Do you ever eat?

lines.ar: طَبْعًا آكُلُ! أُمِّي طَبَّاخَة مُمْتَازَة. لٰكِنِّي لَسْتُ قَوِيًّا مِثْلَ عُمَر!
lines.en: Of course I eat! My mother is an excellent cook. But I'm not as strong as Omar!

lines.ar: هٰذَا صَحِيح! أَنَا قَوِيّ مِثْلَ أَبِي. وَأَنْتِ يَا نُور، لَسْتِ هَادِئَةً أَبَدًا!
lines.en: That's true! I'm strong like my father. And you, Nour, you're not quiet at all!

lines.ar: أَنَا هَادِئَة جِدًّا! لٰكِنْ فِي الْبَيْت مَعَكَ، لَا أَحَدَ هَادِئ!
lines.en: I'm very calm! But at home with you around, nobody is calm!

lines.ar: أَنْتُمْ مُضْحِكُونَ جِدًّا! فِي أَمْرِيكَا، أُخْتِي إِيمَا قَصِيرَة، وَهِيَ لَيْسَتْ هَادِئَةً أَيْضًا.
lines.en: You are all very funny! In America my sister Emma is short, and she isn't quiet either.

lines.ar: إِذَنْ هِيَ مِثْلُ نُور! وَالْآن، هَيَّا نَلْعَبْ كُرَةَ السَّلَّة!
lines.en: So she's just like Nour! And now, come on, let's play basketball!

reading.title: Sami's brother and sister
reading.ar: سَامِي شَابّ طَوِيل وَنَحِيف. أَخُوهُ عُمَر لَيْسَ طَوِيلًا، لٰكِنَّهُ قَوِيّ جِدًّا. أُخْتُهُ نُور صَغِيرَة، وَهِيَ لَيْسَتْ هَادِئَةً أَبَدًا!
reading.en: Sami is a tall, thin young man. His brother Omar is not tall, but he is very strong. His sister Nour is little, and she is not quiet at all!

quiz.prompt: What is the opposite of طَوِيل?
Choose the correct sentence: 'Nour is not tall.'
How do you say 'I am not'?
Why does the adjective end in ـًا in لَيْسَ طَوِيلًا?
Who is very thin, according to Daniel?
Which letter is the deep q, made at the back of the mouth, in قَصِير?

completion: Brilliant! You can describe people with opposites and say what someone is not.
